text1TermsOfService: The device malfunction is caused by a violation of the rules for its operation, transportation, and storage, as specified in the user manual.
text2TermsOfService: The original serial number is missing, damaged, or unreadable on the device.
text3TermsOfService: The device has missing or damaged factory or warranty seals and stickers.
text4TermsOfService: The device was repaired, maintained, or upgraded by individuals who were not authorized by the manufacturer.
text5TermsOfService: Device defects are caused by using the device with software that is not included with the device or is not approved for use by the device manufacturer.
text6TermsOfService: Keep the purchase receipt. This will save you time when applying for a warranty.
text7TermsOfService: If the receipt is lost or damaged, then:
text8TermsOfService: prepare information in advance about when and where you purchased the product (exact or approximate purchase date, store), and whether any accessories or other devices were purchased with the product;
text9TermsOfService: contact the service center or store with the product and all the information about its purchase.
text10TermsOfService: The specialist will find your purchase in the database and suggest a solution to the current situation.
text11TermsOfService: If it is a large-sized appliance, you can contact the service center by phone and order a service for removing large-sized appliances or calling a technician to your home (if the service is available in your region).
text12TermsOfService: If your product is medium-sized or smaller, you can also contact the service center by phone and be consulted remotely about any issues with your product.
text13TermsOfService: Typical products in this category include refrigerators, washing machines, electric and gas stoves, dishwashers, built-in ovens, air purifiers, and TVs with a diagonal size of 40″ or more.
